changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_curated_group_override_based_on' AND conrelid = 'public.curated_group_override'::regclass

changeSet.comment: Accept the group digest the catalogue writes and keep every stored earlier group digest valid. No row changes: the new predicate admits every value the earlier one did.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE curated_group_override DROP CONSTRAINT ck_curated_group_override_based_on, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_curated_group_override_based_on CHECK ( based_on_digest IS NULL OR based_on_digest ~ '^(area|group):v1:[0-9a-f]{64}$');

rollback.stop: Restore a verified database backup made before this upgrade. Group digests saved since then do not satisfy the earlier constraint.
